    设定目标¶

    我认为当务之急是选定一个目标，然后全身心投入。抛开一切无关紧要的事情、欲望，全力去做。

    08:24~09:31 让Gemini帮我重新优化设计了Anki卡片的样式。结构深得我心，只是还需要收集中意的配色体系。

    09:57 软件分享

    • CopyTranslator 开源复制即翻译的外文辅助阅读翻译解决方案。
    • Umi-OCR 开源、免费的离线OCR软件。支持截屏/批量导入图片，PDF文档识别，排除水印/页眉页脚，扫描/生成二维码。

    10:10 GPT-Image-2 提示词 Github开源提示词库

    (function () {
    // 1. 创建并添加 Canvas 画布到页面
    const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    canvas.id = 'fireworks-canvas';
    document.body.appendChild(canvas);

    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    let particles = [];

    // 2. 自动调整画布大小
    function resizeCanvas() {
        canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
        canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
    }
    resizeCanvas();
    window.addEventListener('resize', resizeCanvas);

    // 3. 烟花粒子类
    class Particle {
        constructor(x, y) {
            this.x = x;
            this.y = y;
            // 随机散射角度和速度
            const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
            const speed = Math.random() * 4 + 2; 

            this.vx = Math.cos(angle) * speed;
            this.vy = Math.sin(angle) * speed;

            // 粒子重力加速（往下坠）和阻力
            this.gravity = 0.06;
            this.resistance = 0.96; 

            // 随机大小和五彩颜色
            this.size = Math.random() * 3 + 1.5;
            this.alpha = 1;
            this.fade = Math.random() * 0.015 + 0.015; // 渐隐速度
            this.color = `hsl(${Math.random() * 360}, 100%, 60%)`; // 随机HSL高饱和度色彩
        }

        update() {
            this.vx *= this.resistance;
            this.vy *= this.resistance;
            this.vy += this.gravity;
            this.x += this.vx;
            this.y += this.vy;
            this.alpha -= this.fade;
        }

        draw() {
            ctx.save();
            ctx.globalAlpha = this.alpha;
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.arc(this.x, this.y, this.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            ctx.fillStyle = this.color;
            // 增加发光特效（如果觉得卡可以删掉 shadow 两行）
            ctx.shadowBlur = 6;
            ctx.shadowColor = this.color;
            ctx.fill();
            ctx.restore();
        }
    }

    // 4. 监听鼠标点击事件
    window.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        // 每次点击生成 30-40 个烟花粒子
        const particleCount = Math.floor(Math.random() * 15) + 25;
        // 注意：使用 clientX 而不是 pageX，因为 Canvas 是 fixed 固定定位
        for (let i = 0; i < particleCount; i++) {
            particles.push(new Particle(e.clientX, e.clientY));
        }
    });

    // 5. 动画主循环
    function animate() {
        // 清理上一帧的画布
        ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

        // 更新并绘制所有粒子
        for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            const p = particles[i];
            p.update();
            if (p.alpha <= 0) {
                particles.splice(i, 1); // 销毁透明粒子
            } else {
                p.draw();
            }
        }
        requestAnimationFrame(animate);
    }

    // 启动动画
    animate();
})();

    (function () {
    const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    canvas.id = 'fireworks-canvas';
    document.body.appendChild(canvas);
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

    let particles = [];
    const mouse = { x: null, y: null, max: 20000 }; // 鼠标吸附范围

    function resize() {
        canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
        canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
    }
    resize();
    window.addEventListener('resize', resize);

    // 监听鼠标移动
    window.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
        mouse.x = e.clientX;
        mouse.y = e.clientY;
    });
    window.addEventListener('mouseout', () => {
        mouse.x = null;
        mouse.y = null;
    });

    // 预先生成一些随机漂浮的背景粒子
    const particleCount = 80;
    for (let i = 0; i < particleCount; i++) {
        particles.push({
            x: Math.random() * canvas.width,
            y: Math.random() * canvas.height,
            vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 1,
            vy: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 1,
            max: 6000 // 线条连线距离
        });
    }

    // 将鼠标作为一个特殊粒子加入计算
    let allParticles = [mouse].concat(particles);

    function animate() {
        ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

        particles.forEach(p => {
            // 粒子移动和边界反弹
            p.x += p.vx;
            p.y += p.vy;
            if (p.x < 0 || p.x > canvas.width) p.vx *= -1;
            if (p.y < 0 || p.y > canvas.height) p.vy *= -1;

            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 150, 255, 0.5)'; // 粒子呈科技蓝
            ctx.fillRect(p.x - 0.5, p.y - 0.5, 2, 2);

            // 循环计算与其他粒子的距离，如果足够近就画线
            for (let i = 0; i < allParticles.length; i++) {
                const a = allParticles[i];
                if (p === a || a.x === null || a.y === null) continue;

                const dx = p.x - a.x;
                const dy = p.y - a.y;
                const dist = dx * dx + dy * dy;

                if (dist < a.max) {
                    // 如果是鼠标，让粒子产生微微向鼠标靠拢的吸附感
                    if (a === mouse && dist > a.max / 2) {
                        p.x -= dx * 0.03;
                        p.y -= dy * 0.03;
                    }
                    // 距离越近，线条越明显
                    const alpha = (a.max - dist) / a.max;
                    ctx.beginPath();
                    ctx.lineWidth = alpha / 2;
                    ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(0, 180, 255, ${alpha})`; // 连线颜色
                    ctx.moveTo(p.x, p.y);
                    ctx.lineTo(a.x, a.y);
                    ctx.stroke();
                }
            }
        });
        requestAnimationFrame(animate);
    }
    animate();
})();

    (function () {
    const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    canvas.id = 'fireworks-canvas';
    document.body.appendChild(canvas);
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    let stars = [];

    function resize() {
        canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
        canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
    }
    resize();
    window.addEventListener('resize', resize);

    class Star {
        constructor(x, y) {
            this.x = x;
            this.y = y;
            this.size = Math.random() * 4 + 2;
            this.speedX = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 1.5;
            this.speedY = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 1.5;
            this.color = `hsl(${Math.random() * 60 + 200}, 100%, 75%)`; // 偏梦幻冰蓝/淡紫调
            this.alpha = 1;
            this.rotate = Math.random() * Math.PI;
            this.rotateSpeed = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.1;
        }
        update() {
            this.x += this.speedX;
            this.y += this.speedY;
            this.alpha -= 0.02;
            this.rotate += this.rotateSpeed;
        }
        draw() {
            ctx.save();
            ctx.translate(this.x, this.y);
            ctx.rotate(this.rotate);
            ctx.globalAlpha = this.alpha;
            ctx.fillStyle = this.color;
            ctx.shadowBlur = 10;
            ctx.shadowColor = this.color;

            // 绘制标准的四角星
            ctx.beginPath();
            for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                ctx.lineTo(0, -this.size);
                ctx.lineTo(this.size / 3, -this.size / 3);
                ctx.rotate(Math.PI / 2);
            }
            ctx.closePath();
            ctx.fill();
            ctx.restore();
        }
    }


    // 捕捉移动路径，只要移动就不断塞入星星
    window.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
        // 控制一下生成频率，避免太密集
        if (Math.random() > 0.8) {
            stars.push(new Star(e.clientX, e.clientY));
        }
    });

    function animate() {
        ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
        for (let i = stars.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            stars[i].update();
            if (stars[i].alpha <= 0) {
                stars.splice(i, 1);
            } else {
                stars[i].draw();
            }
        }
        requestAnimationFrame(animate);
    }
    animate();
})();

    // docs/js/cursor-trail.js – 视觉强化版
(function () {
  const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

  // 配置（可通过 window.cursorTrailConfig 覆盖）
  const config = {
    trailLength: 20,          // 拖尾点数
    maxSparkles: 40,          // 最大粒子数
    lineWidthBase: 1,         // 基础线宽
    lineWidthSpeedFactor: 0.1,// 线宽随速度变化的系数，保持基础线宽不变，决定速度对线条粗心的影响
    glowWidth: 1,            // 外发光模糊半径
    sparkleSizeMin: 1.5,      // 粒子的大小
    sparkleSizeMax: 3.5,
    fadeOutTime: 550,         // 轨迹淡出时间(ms)
    idleSparkles: true,       // 静止粒子
    clickBurst: true,         // 点击爆发
  };

  // 状态
  let trail = [];
  let sparkles = [];
  let mouseX = 0, mouseY = 0;
  let prevMouseX = 0, prevMouseY = 0;
  let speed = 0;
  let lastMoveTime = 0;
  let globalHue = 0;          // 全局色相，持续旋转

  // 画布设置
  canvas.style.position = 'fixed';
  canvas.style.top = '0';
  canvas.style.left = '0';
  canvas.style.width = '100%';
  canvas.style.height = '100%';
  canvas.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
  canvas.style.zIndex = '999999';
  document.body.appendChild(canvas);

  function resize() {
    canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
    canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
  }
  window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
  resize();

  // 粒子类
  class Sparkle {
    constructor(x, y, hueOffset = 0) {
      this.x = x;
      this.y = y;
      const hue = (globalHue + hueOffset) % 360;
      this.color = `hsl(${hue}, 90%, 70%)`;
      this.size = config.sparkleSizeMin + Math.random() * (config.sparkleSizeMax - config.sparkleSizeMin);
      this.speedX = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 3;
      this.speedY = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 3;
      this.life = 1;
      this.decay = 0.015 + Math.random() * 0.04;
      this.rotation = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
      this.rotationSpeed = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.3;
      // 随机形状 0:四角星, 1:圆点, 2:六角星(简化), 3:空心圆
      this.shape = Math.floor(Math.random() * 4);
    }

    update() {
      this.x += this.speedX;
      this.y += this.speedY;
      this.life -= this.decay;
      this.rotation += this.rotationSpeed;
    }

    draw(ctx) {
      if (this.life <= 0) return;
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(this.x, this.y);
      ctx.rotate(this.rotation);
      ctx.globalAlpha = this.life * 0.9;
      ctx.fillStyle = this.color;
      ctx.strokeStyle = this.color;
      ctx.lineWidth = 1;
      ctx.shadowBlur = 6;
      ctx.shadowColor = this.color;

      const s = this.size;
      switch (this.shape) {
        case 0: // 四角星
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(0, -s);
          ctx.lineTo(s * 0.35, -s * 0.35);
          ctx.lineTo(s, 0);
          ctx.lineTo(s * 0.35, s * 0.35);
          ctx.lineTo(0, s);
          ctx.lineTo(-s * 0.35, s * 0.35);
          ctx.lineTo(-s, 0);
          ctx.lineTo(-s * 0.35, -s * 0.35);
          ctx.closePath();
          ctx.fill();
          break;
        case 1: // 实心圆
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.arc(0, 0, s * 0.7, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.fill();
          break;
        case 2: // 六角星（简单绘制两个三角形叠加）
          ctx.beginPath();
          for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
            const angle = (i * Math.PI) / 3 - Math.PI / 2;
            const r = i % 2 === 0 ? s : s * 0.4;
            ctx.lineTo(Math.cos(angle) * r, Math.sin(angle) * r);
          }
          ctx.closePath();
          ctx.fill();
          break;
        case 3: // 空心圆
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.arc(0, 0, s * 0.6, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.stroke();
          break;
      }
      ctx.restore();
    }
  }

  // 绘制拖尾线条（双层发光）
  function drawTrail() {
    if (trail.length < 2) return;
    const now = performance.now();

    ctx.save();
    ctx.lineCap = 'round';
    ctx.lineJoin = 'round';

    // 第一遍：外发光层（更宽、更透明）
    for (let pass = 0; pass < 2; pass++) {
      const isGlow = pass === 0;
      for (let i = 1; i < trail.length; i++) {
        const p0 = trail[i - 1];
        const p1 = trail[i];
        const age0 = now - p0.timestamp;
        const age1 = now - p1.timestamp;
        const alpha0 = Math.max(0, 1 - age0 / config.fadeOutTime);
        const alpha1 = Math.max(0, 1 - age1 / config.fadeOutTime);
        if (alpha0 <= 0 && alpha1 <= 0) continue;

        // 计算线宽：基础宽度 + 速度加成，并沿轨迹递减
        const widthFactor0 = 1 - (age0 / config.fadeOutTime) * 0.6;
        const widthFactor1 = 1 - (age1 / config.fadeOutTime) * 0.6;
        const w0 = (config.lineWidthBase + p0.speed * config.lineWidthSpeedFactor) * widthFactor0;
        const w1 = (config.lineWidthBase + p1.speed * config.lineWidthSpeedFactor) * widthFactor1;

        // 颜色：根据全局色相和点在轨迹中的位置调整
        const hue0 = (p0.hue) % 360;
        const hue1 = (p1.hue) % 360;
        const color0 = `hsla(${hue0}, 90%, 70%, ${isGlow ? alpha0 * 0.4 : alpha0})`;
        const color1 = `hsla(${hue1}, 90%, 70%, ${isGlow ? alpha1 * 0.4 : alpha1})`;

        const gradient = ctx.createLinearGradient(p0.x, p0.y, p1.x, p1.y);
        gradient.addColorStop(0, color0);
        gradient.addColorStop(1, color1);

        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.strokeStyle = gradient;
        ctx.lineWidth = isGlow ? Math.max(w0, w1) + config.glowWidth : Math.min(w0, w1);
        ctx.shadowBlur = isGlow ? 15 : 8;
        ctx.shadowColor = `hsl(${hue1}, 90%, 70%)`;
        ctx.moveTo(p0.x, p0.y);

        if (i < trail.length - 1) {
          const p2 = trail[i + 1];
          const midX = (p1.x + p2.x) / 2;
          const midY = (p1.y + p2.y) / 2;
          ctx.quadraticCurveTo(p1.x, p1.y, midX, midY);
        } else {
          ctx.lineTo(p1.x, p1.y);
        }
        ctx.stroke();
      }
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }

  // 动画循环
  function animate() {
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    const now = performance.now();

    // 全局色相缓慢旋转，使闲置时也有颜色变化
    globalHue = (globalHue + 0.8) % 360;

    // 清理过期轨迹
    while (trail.length > 0 && now - trail[0].timestamp > config.fadeOutTime) {
      trail.shift();
    }

    // 更新绘制粒子
    for (let i = sparkles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      sparkles[i].update();
      sparkles[i].draw(ctx);
      if (sparkles[i].life <= 0) sparkles.splice(i, 1);
    }

    drawTrail();

    // 静止环绕粒子
    if (config.idleSparkles && trail.length > 0 && now - lastMoveTime > 120) {
      const last = trail[trail.length - 1];
      if (Math.random() < 0.3) {
        const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
        const dist = 4 + Math.random() * 12;
        sparkles.push(new Sparkle(
          last.x + Math.cos(angle) * dist,
          last.y + Math.sin(angle) * dist,
          Math.random() * 30
        ));
        if (sparkles.length > config.maxSparkles) sparkles.shift();
      }
    }

    requestAnimationFrame(animate);
  }


  // 鼠标移动
  document.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
    prevMouseX = mouseX;
    prevMouseY = mouseY;
    mouseX = e.clientX;
    mouseY = e.clientY;

    // 跳过首次移动产生的巨大速度（prevMouse 为 0 时）
    if (prevMouseX === 0 && prevMouseY === 0) {
        lastMoveTime = performance.now();
        return;
    }

    speed = Math.hypot(mouseX - prevMouseX, mouseY - prevMouseY);
    lastMoveTime = performance.now();

    // 新轨迹点，hue 基于全局色相，并加上速度偏移，使移动时色彩变化更快
    const hue = (globalHue + speed * 0.8) % 360;
    trail.push({
      x: mouseX,
      y: mouseY,
      hue: hue,
      speed: speed,
      timestamp: performance.now()
    });
    while (trail.length > config.trailLength) trail.shift();

    // 移动时撒落粒子
    const sparkCount = Math.min(2, Math.floor(speed / 4) + 1);
    for (let i = 0; i < sparkCount; i++) {
      sparkles.push(new Sparkle(
        mouseX + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 10,
        mouseY + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 10,
        Math.random() * 30 - 15
      ));
      if (sparkles.length > config.maxSparkles) sparkles.shift();
    }
  });

  // 点击爆发
  document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    if (!config.clickBurst) return;
    for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
      const angle = (i / 8) * Math.PI * 2;
      const dist = 5;
      sparkles.push(new Sparkle(
        e.clientX + Math.cos(angle) * dist,
        e.clientY + Math.sin(angle) * dist,
        i * 45
      ));
    }
    // 额外随机散落
    for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
      sparkles.push(new Sparkle(
        e.clientX + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 15,
        e.clientY + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 15,
        Math.random() * 360
      ));
    }
  });

  // 鼠标离开窗口时清空
  document.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
    trail.length = 0;
    sparkles.length = 0;
  });

  // 页面不可见时暂停粒子生成
  document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => {
    if (document.hidden) {
      trail.length = 0;
      sparkles.length = 0;
    }
  });

  // 暴露配置到全局
  window.cursorTrailConfig = config;

  animate();
})();

    // docs/js/rain-effect.js – 专为 MkDocs 优化的全屏高性能雨景特效
(function () {
    const CANVAS_ID = 'mkdocs-rain-canvas';

    // 1. 防御机制：防止 MkDocs 异步刷新重复创建画布
    if (document.getElementById(CANVAS_ID)) return;

    const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    canvas.id = CANVAS_ID;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    let raindrops = [];
    let animationFrameId = null;

    // ==========================================
    // 🎛️ 可配置参数（针对雨景优化）
    // ==========================================
    const CONFIG = {
        maxRaindrops: 60,             // 同时存在的雨滴数量（30-80 体验最佳，既有氛围又不喧宾夺主）
        minSpeed: 8,                  // 雨滴最小下落速度 (px/帧，雨水下落较快)
        maxSpeed: 15,                 // 雨滴最大下落速度
        wind: -1.5,                   // 雨水倾斜度/风向（负值向左飘，正值向右飘，0 为垂直下落）
        minLength: 10,                // 雨滴线条最小长度 (px)
        maxLength: 25,                // 雨滴线条最大长度 (px)
        opacityRange: [0.15, 0.4],    // 雨滴不透明度范围（保持半透明透明感，保护可读性）
        rainColor: 'rgba(174, 219, 248, ', // 雨水基础颜色 (浅冰蓝，留出末尾拼接透明度)
    };

    // 2. 样式设置
    canvas.style.position = 'fixed';
    canvas.style.top = '0';
    canvas.style.left = '0';
    canvas.style.width = '100%';
    canvas.style.height = '100%';
    canvas.style.pointerEvents = 'none'; // 确保不影响页面文字选中与链接点击
    canvas.style.zIndex = '999996';      // 经典层级：处于文档背景与文字之间
    canvas.style.willChange = 'transform'; // 硬件加速提示
    document.body.appendChild(canvas);

    // 3. 高清屏（Retina）模糊修复与逻辑空间缩放
    function resize() {
        const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
        canvas.width = window.innerWidth * dpr;
        canvas.height = window.innerHeight * dpr;
        ctx.scale(dpr, dpr); // 缩放绘图上下文
    }
    window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
    resize();

    // ==========================================
    // 🌧️ 雨滴类（符合物理轨迹）
    // ==========================================
    class Raindrop {
        constructor(initial = false) {
            this.reset(initial);
        }

        reset(initial = false) {
            // 考虑风向带来的倾斜，让雨滴生成的 X 轴范围变大，防止屏幕上风向侧出现“无雨空白区”
            const spawnBuffer = Math.abs(CONFIG.wind) * 100;
            this.x = Math.random() * (window.innerWidth + spawnBuffer * 2) - spawnBuffer;

            // 初始化时随机分布在全屏，之后生成的雨滴一律从顶部 (-30px) 落下
            this.y = initial ? Math.random() * window.innerHeight : -Math.random() * 30;

            this.speed = CONFIG.minSpeed + Math.random() * (CONFIG.maxSpeed - CONFIG.minSpeed);
            this.length = CONFIG.minLength + Math.random() * (CONFIG.maxLength - CONFIG.minLength);
            this.opacity = CONFIG.opacityRange[0] + Math.random() * (CONFIG.opacityRange[1] - CONFIG.opacityRange[0]);

            // 微调每个雨滴的独立风向，使其更有层次感
            this.currentWind = CONFIG.wind + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.2;
        }

        update() {
            this.y += this.speed;
            this.x += this.currentWind;

            // 越界检测（超出屏幕底部或两侧则重置）
            if (this.y > window.innerHeight + CONFIG.maxLength || 
                this.x < -50 || 
                this.x > window.innerWidth + 50) {
                this.reset();
            }
        }

        draw(ctx) {
            ctx.save();
            ctx.beginPath();

            // 设置雨水半透明线段样式
            ctx.strokeStyle = CONFIG.rainColor + this.opacity + ')';
            ctx.lineWidth = 1.5; // 雨滴粗细
            ctx.lineCap = 'round';

            // 核心轨迹：基于当前点 (x, y)，根据速度和风向顺着轨迹向上方延长画线
            ctx.moveTo(this.x, this.y);
            ctx.lineTo(this.x - this.currentWind * (this.length / this.speed), this.y - this.length);

            ctx.stroke();
            ctx.restore();
        }
    }

    // 4. 初始化雨滴群
    for (let i = 0; i < CONFIG.maxRaindrops; i++) {
        raindrops.push(new Raindrop(true));
    }

    // 5. 动画主循环
    function animate() {
        ctx.clearRect(0, 0, window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);

        for (const raindrop of raindrops) {
            raindrop.update();
            raindrop.draw(ctx);
        }

        animationFrameId = requestAnimationFrame(animate);
    }
    animate();

    // ==========================================
    // 🧹 针对 MkDocs 瞬时路由切换的内存回收机制
    // ==========================================
    document.addEventListener("DOMNodeRemoved", function (e) {
        if (e.target === canvas) {
            window.removeEventListener('resize', resize);
            if (animationFrameId) cancelAnimationFrame(animationFrameId);
        }
    });

    window.mkdocsRainConfig = CONFIG;
})();

    (function () {
    // 检查是否已经存在，防止 MkDocs 异步刷新重复创建
    if (document.getElementById('snow-flakes-canvas')) return;

    const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    canvas.id = 'snow-flakes-canvas';
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    let flakes = [];
    let animationFrameId = null;

    // ========== 雪花特性可配置参数 ==========
    const CONFIG = {
        maxFlakes: 60,               // 同时存在的雪花数量（雪花可以比花瓣略密一点）
        minSize: 1.5,                // 雪花最小半径 (px)
        maxSize: 4.5,                // 雪花最大半径 (px)
        minSpeed: 0.5,               // 最小下落速度 (px/帧)
        maxSpeed: 1.8,               // 最大下落速度 (px/帧)
        baseWind: 0.1,               // 基础水平风向（正数向右，负数向左）
        opacityRange: [0.3, 0.85],   // 不透明度范围
    };

    // 样式设置（与你原先的层级和穿透属性保持一致，确保不挡住文字和代码块）
    canvas.style.position = 'fixed';
    canvas.style.top = '0';
    canvas.style.left = '0';
    canvas.style.width = '100%';
    canvas.style.height = '100%';
    canvas.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
    canvas.style.zIndex = '999996';
    canvas.style.willChange = 'transform';
    document.body.appendChild(canvas);

    // 解决高清屏模糊的核心逻辑
    function resize() {
        const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
        canvas.width = window.innerWidth * dpr;
        canvas.height = window.innerHeight * dpr;
        ctx.scale(dpr, dpr);
    }
    window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
    resize();

    // 雪花粒子类
    class SnowFlake {
        constructor(initial = false) {
            this.reset(initial);
        }

        reset(initial = false) {
            this.x = Math.random() * window.innerWidth;
            // 初始生成时分散在全屏，后续生成时从顶部 -20px 处落下
            this.y = initial ? Math.random() * window.innerHeight : -20;

            // 核心物理特性绑定：越大、越重的雪花下落越快、越清晰（形成前后景深）
            const sizeProgress = Math.random(); // 0 到 1 之间的随机数
            this.size = CONFIG.minSize + sizeProgress * (CONFIG.maxSize - CONFIG.minSize);
            this.speed = CONFIG.minSpeed + sizeProgress * (CONFIG.maxSpeed - CONFIG.minSpeed);
            this.opacity = CONFIG.opacityRange[0] + sizeProgress * (CONFIG.opacityRange[1] - CONFIG.opacityRange[0]);

            // 左右轻微摆动（Sway）的参数
            this.swingSpeed = 0.01 + Math.random() * 0.02; // 摆动频率
            this.swingRadius = 0.5 + Math.random() * 1.2;  // 左右晃动的幅度（像素）
            this.swingOffset = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2; // 随机初始相位
        }

        update() {
            this.y += this.speed;

            // 雪花轨迹：基础风向 + 正弦曲线高频小幅摆动
            this.swingOffset += this.swingSpeed;
            this.x += CONFIG.baseWind + Math.sin(this.swingOffset) * (this.swingRadius * 0.5);

            // 边界检查：移出屏幕后重置
            if (this.y > window.innerHeight + 10 || this.x < -10 || this.x > window.innerWidth + 10) {
                this.reset();
            }
        }

        draw(ctx) {
            ctx.save();
            ctx.beginPath();
            // 绘制纯色半透明圆形雪花
            ctx.arc(this.x, this.y, this.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255, 255, 255, ${this.opacity})`;

            // 给大雪花添加一点点模糊边缘（微弱的霓虹/发光感，更像真实的雪）
            if (this.size > 3.5) {
                ctx.shadowBlur = 4;
                ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8)';
            }

            ctx.fill();
            ctx.restore();
        }
    }

    // 初始化雪花池
    for (let i = 0; i < CONFIG.maxFlakes; i++) {
        flakes.push(new SnowFlake(true));
    }

    // 主动画循环
    function animate() {
        ctx.clearRect(0, 0, window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);

        for (const flake of flakes) {
            flake.update();
            flake.draw(ctx);
        }

        animationFrameId = requestAnimationFrame(animate);
    }

    // 启动动画
    animate();

    // 针对 MkDocs Material 瞬时加载（Pjax/SPA）模式的内存清理防御机制
    document.addEventListener("DOMNodeRemoved", function(e) {
        if (e.target === canvas) {
            window.removeEventListener('resize', resize);
            if (animationFrameId) cancelAnimationFrame(animationFrameId);
        }
    });

    // 暴露配置项方便后续控制台微调
    window.snowConfig = CONFIG;
})();

    (function () {
    // 检查是否已经存在，防止 MkDocs 异步刷新重复创建
    if (document.getElementById('snow-flakes-canvas')) return;

    const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    canvas.id = 'snow-flakes-canvas';
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    let flakes = [];
    let animationFrameId = null;

    // ========== 可配置参数 ==========
    const CONFIG = {
        maxFlakes: 40,               // 同时存在的雪花数量
        minSize: 10,                 // 雪花最小尺寸 (px)
        maxSize: 28,                 // 雪花最大尺寸 (px)
        minSpeed: 0.4,               // 最小下落速度 (px/帧)
        maxSpeed: 1.5,               // 最大下落速度
        baseWind: 0.1,               // 基础水平风向
        opacityRange: [0.3, 0.85],   // 不透明度范围 [最小, 最大]
    };

    // 样式设置
    canvas.style.position = 'fixed';
    canvas.style.top = '0';
    canvas.style.left = '0';
    canvas.style.width = '100%';
    canvas.style.height = '100%';
    canvas.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
    canvas.style.zIndex = '999996';
    canvas.style.willChange = 'transform';
    document.body.appendChild(canvas);

    // 解决高清屏模糊的核心逻辑
    function resize() {
        const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
        canvas.width = window.innerWidth * dpr;
        canvas.height = window.innerHeight * dpr;
        ctx.scale(dpr, dpr);
    }
    window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
    resize();

    // 自动匹配目录并加载同级目录下的 snow.svg
    const snowImg = new Image();
    try {
        const currentScript = document.querySelector('script[src*="background.js"]');
        if (currentScript) {
            // 保持和你之前完全相同的路径替换逻辑，自动指向对应的 svg/ 目录
            snowImg.src = currentScript.src.replace('js/background.js', 'svg/snow.svg');
        } else {
            snowImg.src = 'assets/svg/snow.svg'; // 回退相对路径
        }
    } catch (e) {
        snowImg.src = 'assets/svg/snow.svg';
    }

    class SnowFlake {
        constructor(initial = false) {
            this.reset(initial);
        }

        reset(initial = false) {
            this.x = Math.random() * window.innerWidth;
            this.y = initial ? Math.random() * window.innerHeight : -Math.random() * 30;

            // 景深绑定：大雪花重 -> 下落快 -> 在前景（较清晰）；小雪花轻 -> 下落慢 -> 在背景（较透明）
            const sizeProgress = Math.random();
            this.size = CONFIG.minSize + sizeProgress * (CONFIG.maxSize - CONFIG.minSize);
            this.speed = CONFIG.minSpeed + sizeProgress * (CONFIG.maxSpeed - CONFIG.minSpeed);
            this.opacity = CONFIG.opacityRange[0] + sizeProgress * (CONFIG.opacityRange[1] - CONFIG.opacityRange[0]);

            // 左右摇摆物理参数
            this.swingSpeed = 0.01 + Math.random() * 0.015; // 摆动频率
            this.swingRadius = 0.3 + Math.random() * 0.8;   // 左右摆动幅度
            this.swingOffset = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2; // 随机初始相位
        }

        update() {
            this.y += this.speed;
            this.swingOffset += this.swingSpeed;

            // 计算当前帧的摆动偏移量
            const currentSwing = Math.sin(this.swingOffset);
            this.x += CONFIG.baseWind + currentSwing * this.swingRadius;

            // 让雪花随摆动方向产生极其轻微的左右倾斜（角度随正弦波交替，非持续自转）
            this.rotation = currentSwing * 0.08; 

            if (this.y > window.innerHeight + 30 || this.x < -30 || this.x > window.innerWidth + 30) {
                this.reset();
            }
        }

        draw(ctx) {
            if (!snowImg.complete || snowImg.naturalWidth === 0) return;

            ctx.save();
            ctx.translate(this.x, this.y);
            ctx.rotate(this.rotation);
            ctx.globalAlpha = this.opacity;

            // 将 SVG 图片居中绘制
            ctx.drawImage(snowImg, -this.size / 2, -this.size / 2, this.size, this.size);
            ctx.restore();
        }
    }

    // 初始化雪花池
    for (let i = 0; i < CONFIG.maxFlakes; i++) {
        flakes.push(new SnowFlake(true));
    }

    // 动画主循环
    function animate() {
        ctx.clearRect(0, 0, window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);

        for (const flake of flakes) {
            flake.update();
            flake.draw(ctx);
        }

        animationFrameId = requestAnimationFrame(animate);
    }

    // 确保图片加载完成后再启动，避免初次加载时白屏或报错
    if (snowImg.complete) {
        animate();
    } else {
        snowImg.onload = animate;
    }

    // 针对 MkDocs Material 异步刷新的卸载防御
    document.addEventListener("DOMNodeRemoved", function(e) {
        if (e.target === canvas) {
            window.removeEventListener('resize', resize);
            if (animationFrameId) cancelAnimationFrame(animationFrameId);
        }
    });

    window.snowConfig = CONFIG;
})();

    // docs/js/star-rain.js – 全屏高性能星星雨
(function () {
    const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    canvas.id = 'star-rain-canvas';
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    let stars = [];
    let cachedStars = {}; // 用于存储离屏缓存的星星位图

    // ========== 可配置参数 ==========
    const CONFIG = {
        maxStars: 80,               // 同时存在的星星数量
        minSpeed: 0.3,              // 最小下落速度 (px/帧)
        maxSpeed: 1.2,              // 最大下落速度
        wind: -0.2,                 // 水平飘移
        minSize: 2,                 // 星星最小尺寸
        maxSize: 5,                 // 星星最大尺寸
        opacity: 0.8,               // 星星基础不透明度
        shadowBlur: 6,              // 发光模糊半径（现在由离屏Canvas处理，不再卡顿）
        hueRange: [200, 260],       // 色相范围（冰蓝到淡紫）
        saturation: '80%',
        lightness: '75%',
        rotationSpeed: 0.02,        // 自转速度
    };

    // 画布样式
    canvas.style.position = 'fixed';
    canvas.style.top = '0';
    canvas.style.left = '0';
    canvas.style.width = '100%';
    canvas.style.height = '100%';
    canvas.style.margin = '0';
    canvas.style.padding = '0';
    canvas.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
    canvas.style.zIndex = '999997'; 
    canvas.style.transform = 'translateZ(0)'; // 开启 GPU 硬件加速
    canvas.style.willChange = 'transform';    // 提示浏览器做好合成层优化
    document.body.appendChild(canvas);

    // ==========================================
    // 💡 核心优化：离屏 Canvas 缓存生成器
    // ==========================================
    function createOffscreenStar(size, color) {
        const cacheKey = `${size}_${color}`;
        if (cachedStars[cacheKey]) return cachedStars[cacheKey]; // 如果生成过，直接返回

        const offscreenCanvas = document.createElement('canvas');
        const offCtx = offscreenCanvas.getContext('2d');

        // 预留足够的空间容纳发光阴影（半径为 shadowBlur）
        const padding = CONFIG.shadowBlur * 2;
        const halfPadding = CONFIG.shadowBlur;
        const totalSize = size * 2 + padding;

        offscreenCanvas.width = totalSize;
        offscreenCanvas.height = totalSize;

        // 设置阴影发光特效
        offCtx.shadowBlur = CONFIG.shadowBlur;
        offCtx.shadowColor = color;
        offCtx.fillStyle = color;

        // 在离屏画布中心绘制四角星
        const cx = totalSize / 2;
        const cy = totalSize / 2;
        const inner = size * 0.4;

        offCtx.beginPath();
        for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
            const angleOuter = (i * Math.PI) / 2 - Math.PI / 2;
            const angleInner = angleOuter + Math.PI / 4;
            const outerX = cx + Math.cos(angleOuter) * size;
            const outerY = cy + Math.sin(angleOuter) * size;
            const innerX = cx + Math.cos(angleInner) * inner;
            const innerY = cy + Math.sin(angleInner) * inner;
            if (i === 0) {
                offCtx.moveTo(outerX, outerY);
            } else {
                offCtx.lineTo(outerX, outerY);
            }
            offCtx.lineTo(innerX, innerY);
        }
        offCtx.closePath();
        offCtx.fill();

        // 缓存这个离屏画布对象，以及它绘制时的中心偏移量
        cachedStars[cacheKey] = {
            canvas: offscreenCanvas,
            offsetX: -totalSize / 2,
            offsetY: -totalSize / 2
        };
        return cachedStars[cacheKey];
    }

    // 窗口尺寸调整（带轻量防抖）
    let resizeTimeout;
    function resize() {
        canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
        canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
    }
    window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
        clearTimeout(resizeTimeout);
        resizeTimeout = setTimeout(resize, 150);
    });
    resize();

    // ==========================================
    // 🌟 星星类 (面向对象)
    // ==========================================
    class Star {
        constructor(initial = false) {
            this.reset(initial);
        }

        reset(initial = false) {
            this.x = Math.random() * canvas.width;
            this.y = initial ? Math.random() * canvas.height : -Math.random() * 30;

            // 四舍五入尺寸，减少离屏缓存碎片（比如 3.2 和 3.4 都归为 3）
            this.size = Math.round(CONFIG.minSize + Math.random() * (CONFIG.maxSize - CONFIG.minSize));
            this.speed = CONFIG.minSpeed + Math.random() * (CONFIG.maxSpeed - CONFIG.minSpeed);
            this.wind = CONFIG.wind + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.3; 
            this.rotation = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
            this.rotationDir = Math.random() < 0.5 ? -1 : 1; 

            const hue = Math.round(CONFIG.hueRange[0] + Math.random() * (CONFIG.hueRange[1] - CONFIG.hueRange[0]));
            this.color = `hsl(${hue}, ${CONFIG.saturation}, ${CONFIG.lightness})`;
            this.opacity = CONFIG.opacity * (0.7 + Math.random() * 0.3);

            // 初始化时立刻把这个星星的离屏缓存图片建立好
            this.starCache = createOffscreenStar(this.size, this.color);
        }

        update() {
            this.y += this.speed;
            this.x += this.wind;
            this.rotation += CONFIG.rotationSpeed * this.rotationDir;

            if (this.y > canvas.height + 20 || this.x < -30 || this.x > canvas.width + 30) {
                this.reset();
            }
        }

        draw(ctx) {
            ctx.save();
            ctx.translate(this.x, this.y);
            ctx.rotate(this.rotation);
            ctx.globalAlpha = this.opacity;

            // 💡 性能蜕变：直接把内存里画好的星星图片贴过来，免去复杂的数学计算和阴影渲染
            ctx.drawImage(
                this.starCache.canvas, 
                this.starCache.offsetX, 
                this.starCache.offsetY
            );

            ctx.restore();
        }
    }

    // 生成星星
    for (let i = 0; i < CONFIG.maxStars; i++) {
        stars.push(new Star(true));
    }

    // 动画主循环
    function animate() {
        ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

        for (let i = 0; i < stars.length; i++) {
            stars[i].update();
            stars[i].draw(ctx);
        }

        requestAnimationFrame(animate);
    }

    animate();

    // 暴露配置
    window.starRainConfig = CONFIG;
})();

    // 🌟 注册为全局大管家可调用的特工：EffectStar
window.EffectStar = (function () {

    // 将核心控制变量提取到顶部，供 start 和 stop 共享管理
    let canvas = null;
    let ctx = null;
    let stars = [];
    let cachedStars = {}; // 用于存储离屏缓存的星星位图
    let animationFrameId = null; 
    let resizeTimeout = null;

    // ========== 可配置参数（保留你完美的星星参数） ==========
    const CONFIG = {
        maxStars: 80,               // 同时存在的星星数量
        minSpeed: 0.3,              // 最小下落速度 (px/帧)
        maxSpeed: 1.2,              // 最大下落速度
        wind: -0.2,                 // 水平飘移
        minSize: 2,                 // 星星最小尺寸
        maxSize: 5,                 // 星星最大尺寸
        opacity: 0.8,               // 星星基础不透明度
        shadowBlur: 6,              // 发光模糊半径
        hueRange: [200, 260],       // 色相范围（冰蓝到淡紫）
        saturation: '80%',
        lightness: '75%',
        rotationSpeed: 0.02,        // 自转速度
    };

    // ==========================================
    // 💡 核心优化：离屏 Canvas 缓存生成器
    // ==========================================
    function createOffscreenStar(size, color) {
        const cacheKey = `${size}_${color}`;
        if (cachedStars[cacheKey]) return cachedStars[cacheKey]; 

        const offscreenCanvas = document.createElement('canvas');
        const offCtx = offscreenCanvas.getContext('2d');

        const padding = CONFIG.shadowBlur * 2;
        const totalSize = size * 2 + padding;

        offscreenCanvas.width = totalSize;
        offscreenCanvas.height = totalSize;

        offCtx.shadowBlur = CONFIG.shadowBlur;
        offCtx.shadowColor = color;
        offCtx.fillStyle = color;

        const cx = totalSize / 2;
        const cy = totalSize / 2;
        const inner = size * 0.4;

        offCtx.beginPath();
        for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
            const angleOuter = (i * Math.PI) / 2 - Math.PI / 2;
            const angleInner = angleOuter + Math.PI / 4;
            const outerX = cx + Math.cos(angleOuter) * size;
            const outerY = cy + Math.sin(angleOuter) * size;
            const innerX = cx + Math.cos(angleInner) * inner;
            const innerY = cy + Math.sin(angleInner) * inner;
            if (i === 0) {
                offCtx.moveTo(outerX, outerY);
            } else {
                offCtx.lineTo(outerX, outerY);
            }
            offCtx.lineTo(innerX, innerY);
        }
        offCtx.closePath();
        offCtx.fill();

        cachedStars[cacheKey] = {
            canvas: offscreenCanvas,
            offsetX: -totalSize / 2,
            offsetY: -totalSize / 2
        };
        return cachedStars[cacheKey];
    }

    // 窗口尺寸调整（带轻量防抖）
    function resize() {
        if (!canvas) return;
        canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
        canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
    }

    // 包装防抖的监听函数，方便后续解绑
    function onResize() {
        clearTimeout(resizeTimeout);
        resizeTimeout = setTimeout(resize, 150);
    }

    // ==========================================
    // 🌟 星星类 (面向对象)
    // ==========================================
    class Star {
        constructor(initial = false) {
            this.reset(initial);
        }

        reset(initial = false) {
            if (!canvas) return;
            this.x = Math.random() * canvas.width;
            this.y = initial ? Math.random() * canvas.height : -Math.random() * 30;

            this.size = Math.round(CONFIG.minSize + Math.random() * (CONFIG.maxSize - CONFIG.minSize));
            this.speed = CONFIG.minSpeed + Math.random() * (CONFIG.maxSpeed - CONFIG.minSpeed);
            this.wind = CONFIG.wind + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.3; 
            this.rotation = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
            this.rotationDir = Math.random() < 0.5 ? -1 : 1; 

            const hue = Math.round(CONFIG.hueRange[0] + Math.random() * (CONFIG.hueRange[1] - CONFIG.hueRange[0]));
            this.color = `hsl(${hue}, ${CONFIG.saturation}, ${CONFIG.lightness})`;
            this.opacity = CONFIG.opacity * (0.7 + Math.random() * 0.3);

            this.starCache = createOffscreenStar(this.size, this.color);
        }

        update() {
            if (!canvas) return;
            this.y += this.speed;
            this.x += this.wind;
            this.rotation += CONFIG.rotationSpeed * this.rotationDir;

            if (this.y > canvas.height + 20 || this.x < -30 || this.x > canvas.width + 30) {
                this.reset();
            }
        }

        draw(ctx) {
            if (!this.starCache) return;
            ctx.save();
            ctx.translate(this.x, this.y);
            ctx.rotate(this.rotation);
            ctx.globalAlpha = this.opacity;

            ctx.drawImage(
                this.starCache.canvas, 
                this.starCache.offsetX, 
                this.starCache.offsetY
            );

            ctx.restore();
        }
    }

    // 动画主循环
    function animate() {
        if (!ctx || !canvas) return;
        ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

        for (let i = 0; i < stars.length; i++) {
            stars[i].update();
            stars[i].draw(ctx);
        }

        animationFrameId = requestAnimationFrame(animate);
    }

    // ==========================================
    // 遥控器按键一：大管家用来“启动”星星雨的开关
    // ==========================================
    function start() {
        if (document.getElementById('star-rain-canvas')) return;

        // 1. 创建并组装画布
        canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
        canvas.id = 'star-rain-canvas';
        ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

        // 2. 注入样式与硬件加速
        canvas.style.position = 'fixed';
        canvas.style.top = '0';
        canvas.style.left = '0';
        canvas.style.width = '100%';
        canvas.style.height = '100%';
        canvas.style.margin = '0';
        canvas.style.padding = '0';
        canvas.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
        canvas.style.zIndex = '999997'; 
        canvas.style.transform = 'translateZ(0)'; 
        canvas.style.willChange = 'transform';    
        document.body.appendChild(canvas);

        // 3. 绑定窗口缩放
        window.addEventListener('resize', onResize);
        resize();

        // 4. 初始化并装填星星粒子池
        stars = [];
        for (let i = 0; i < CONFIG.maxStars; i++) {
            stars.push(new Star(true));
        }

        // 5. 开启循环动画
        animate();
    }

    // ==========================================
    // 遥控器按键二：大管家用来“关闭并抹除”星星雨的开关
    // ==========================================
    function stop() {
        // 1. 停止动画帧循环，不占 GPU 和显卡
        if (animationFrameId) {
            cancelAnimationFrame(animationFrameId);
            animationFrameId = null;
        }

        // 2. 解绑窗口缩放监听器，清除定时器防抖
        window.removeEventListener('resize', onResize);
        clearTimeout(resizeTimeout);

        // 3. 将 HTML 里的画布彻底移除
        if (canvas && canvas.parentNode) {
            canvas.parentNode.removeChild(canvas);
        }

        // 4. 清空内存，释放离屏 Canvas 的缓存和粒子数组
        canvas = null;
        ctx = null;
        stars = [];
        cachedStars = {}; // 释放占用的内存图片位图
    }

    // 顺便把配置挂载出去以便调试
    window.starRainConfig = CONFIG;

    // ==========================================
    // 核心出厂：将开关上交给 window，供大管家随意调用
    // ==========================================
    return {
        start: start,
        stop: stop
    };

})();

    (function () {
    // 核心检测调度逻辑
    function dispatchEffect() {
        // 1. 如果发现星星雨特工已经在池子里了，直接启动
        if (window.EffectStar && window.EffectStar.start) {
            window.EffectStar.start();
            return;
        }

        // 2. 如果池子里没有星星雨，大管家根据你的路径，动态去抓取 star-rain.js
        const script = document.createElement('script');

        // 🌟 精准匹配你的星星雨存放路径
        script.src = '/assets/js/background/star_rain.js'; 

        // 3. 脚本下载并执行完毕后，大管家立刻按下“启动”遥控器
        script.onload = function() {
            if (window.EffectStar && window.EffectStar.start) {
                window.EffectStar.start();
            }
        };

        // 4. 防御机制：如果路径不幸写错了，在控制台发出显眼警告，不至于让网页卡死
        script.onerror = function() {
            console.error("【大管家报错】未能成功找到星星雨脚本，请检查 /assets/js/background/star-rain.js 路径是否正确。");
        };

        document.head.appendChild(script);
    }

    // ① 网页首次彻底加载完毕时，大管家点名
    if (document.readyState === 'complete') {
        dispatchEffect();
    } else {
        window.addEventListener('load', dispatchEffect);
    }

    // ② 完美适配 MkDocs Material 的 SPA 局部切页模式
    // 确保你点击左侧导航栏换页时，星星依然在全屏完美闪烁，不会中断
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentSwitch", dispatchEffect);
})();

    (function () {
    // 检查是否已经存在，防止 MkDocs 异步刷新重复创建
    if (document.getElementById('maple-leaves-canvas')) return;

    const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    canvas.id = 'maple-leaves-canvas';
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    let leaves = [];
    let animationFrameId = null; // 用于记录动画定时器

    // ========== 可配置参数 ==========
    const CONFIG = {
        maxLeaves: 25,               // 同时存在的枫叶数量（保持优雅，不宜过多）
        minSpeed: 0.6,               // 最小下落速度 (px/帧)
        maxSpeed: 1.5,               // 最大下落速度
        wind: 0.2,                   // 基础水平风向（正值向右飘，负值向左）
        minSize: 10,                 // 枫叶最小尺寸 (px)
        maxSize: 22,                 // 枫叶最大尺寸 (px)
        opacityRange: [0.3, 0.7],    // 不透明度范围 [最小, 最大]，避免喧宾夺主
        rotationSpeed: 0.015,        // 自转速度
    };

    // 样式设置
    canvas.style.position = 'fixed';
    canvas.style.top = '0';
    canvas.style.left = '0';
    canvas.style.width = '100%';
    canvas.style.height = '100%';
    canvas.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
    canvas.style.zIndex = '999996';
    canvas.style.willChange = 'transform'; // 提示浏览器该层可能发生硬件加速转换
    document.body.appendChild(canvas);

    // 解决高清屏模糊的核心逻辑
    function resize() {
        const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
        canvas.width = window.innerWidth * dpr;
        canvas.height = window.innerHeight * dpr;
        ctx.scale(dpr, dpr); // 缩放绘图上下文以匹配物理像素
    }
    window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
    resize();

    // 鲁棒路径：如果探测失败，回退到当前页面相对路径而不是绝对根路径
    const leafImg = new Image();
    try {
        const currentScript = document.querySelector('script[src*="background.js"]');
        if (currentScript) {
            leafImg.src = currentScript.src.replace('js/background.js', 'svg/maple_leaf.svg');
        } else {
            leafImg.src = 'assets/svg/maple_leaf.svg'; // 改为相对路径
        }
    } catch (e) {
        leafImg.src = 'assets/svg/maple_leaf.svg';
    }

    class Leaf {
        constructor(initial = false) {
            this.reset(initial);
        }

        reset(initial = false) {
            // 注意：因为 context 缩放了，这里的坐标逻辑依然使用 innerWidth/Height 的逻辑空间
            this.x = Math.random() * window.innerWidth;
            this.y = initial ? Math.random() * window.innerHeight : -Math.random() * 30;
            this.size = CONFIG.minSize + Math.random() * (CONFIG.maxSize - CONFIG.minSize);
            this.speed = CONFIG.minSpeed + Math.random() * (CONFIG.maxSpeed - CONFIG.minSpeed);
            this.wind = CONFIG.wind + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.2; 
            this.rotation = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
            this.rotationDir = Math.random() < 0.5 ? -1 : 1;
            this.opacity = CONFIG.opacityRange[0] + Math.random() * (CONFIG.opacityRange[1] - CONFIG.opacityRange[0]);
            this.swingSpeed = 0.02 + Math.random() * 0.02;
            this.swingOffset = Math.random() * 100;
        }

        update() {
            this.y += this.speed;
            this.x += this.wind + Math.sin(this.y * this.swingSpeed + this.swingOffset) * 0.4;
            this.rotation += CONFIG.rotationSpeed * this.rotationDir;

            if (this.y > window.innerHeight + 30 || this.x < -30 || this.x > window.innerWidth + 30) {
                this.reset();
            }
        }

        draw(ctx) {
            if (!leafImg.complete || leafImg.naturalWidth === 0) return;

            ctx.save();
            ctx.translate(this.x, this.y);
            ctx.rotate(this.rotation);
            ctx.globalAlpha = this.opacity;
            ctx.drawImage(leafImg, -this.size / 2, -this.size / 2, this.size, this.size);
            ctx.restore();
        }
    }

    for (let i = 0; i < CONFIG.maxLeaves; i++) {
        leaves.push(new Leaf(true));
    }

    function animate() {
        // 清理当前视口矩形
        ctx.clearRect(0, 0, window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);

        for (const leaf of leaves) {
            leaf.update();
            leaf.draw(ctx);
        }

        animationFrameId = requestAnimationFrame(animate);
    }

    if (leafImg.complete) {
        animate();
    } else {
        leafImg.onload = animate;
    }

    // 针对 MkDocs Material 瞬时加载模式的额外防御：
    // 当页面即将被销毁/切换时，清理掉无用的垃圾，防止内存泄漏
    document.addEventListener("DOMNodeRemoved", function(e) {
        if (e.target === canvas) {
            window.removeEventListener('resize', resize);
            if (animationFrameId) cancelAnimationFrame(animationFrameId);
        }
    });

    window.mapleLeavesConfig = CONFIG;
})();

    // 🌟 注册为全局大管家可调用的特工：EffectMaple
window.EffectMaple = (function () {

    // 将核心控制变量提取到顶部，供 start 和 stop 共享管理
    let canvas = null;
    let ctx = null;
    let leaves = [];
    let animationFrameId = null; 

    // ========== 可配置参数（保留你完美的枫叶参数） ==========
    const CONFIG = {
        maxLeaves: 25,               // 同时存在的枫叶数量（保持优雅，不宜过多）
        minSpeed: 0.6,               // 最小下落速度 (px/帧)
        maxSpeed: 1.5,               // 最大下落速度
        wind: 0.2,                   // 基础水平风向（正值向右飘，负值向左）
        minSize: 10,                 // 枫叶最小尺寸 (px)
        maxSize: 22,                 // 枫叶最大尺寸 (px)
        opacityRange: [0.3, 0.7],    // 不透明度范围 [最小, 最大]，避免喧宾夺主
        rotationSpeed: 0.015,        // 自转速度
    };

    // 解决高清屏模糊的核心逻辑
    function resize() {
        if (!canvas || !ctx) return;
        const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
        canvas.width = window.innerWidth * dpr;
        canvas.height = window.innerHeight * dpr;
        ctx.scale(dpr, dpr); // 缩放绘图上下文以匹配物理像素
    }

    // 鲁棒路径：如果探测失败，回退到当前页面相对路径而不是绝对根路径
    const leafImg = new Image();
    try {
        const currentScript = document.querySelector('script[src*="background.js"]');
        if (currentScript) {
            leafImg.src = currentScript.src.replace('js/background.js', 'svg/maple_leaf.svg');
        } else {
            leafImg.src = 'assets/svg/maple_leaf.svg'; 
        }
    } catch (e) {
        leafImg.src = 'assets/svg/maple_leaf.svg';
    }

    // 枫叶粒子类
    class Leaf {
        constructor(initial = false) {
            this.reset(initial);
        }

        reset(initial = false) {
            if (!canvas) return;
            // 因为 context 缩放了，这里的坐标逻辑依然使用 innerWidth/Height 的逻辑空间
            this.x = Math.random() * window.innerWidth;
            this.y = initial ? Math.random() * window.innerHeight : -Math.random() * 30;
            this.size = CONFIG.minSize + Math.random() * (CONFIG.maxSize - CONFIG.minSize);
            this.speed = CONFIG.minSpeed + Math.random() * (CONFIG.maxSpeed - CONFIG.minSpeed);
            this.wind = CONFIG.wind + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.2; 
            this.rotation = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
            this.rotationDir = Math.random() < 0.5 ? -1 : 1;
            this.opacity = CONFIG.opacityRange[0] + Math.random() * (CONFIG.opacityRange[1] - CONFIG.opacityRange[0]);
            this.swingSpeed = 0.02 + Math.random() * 0.02;
            this.swingOffset = Math.random() * 100;
        }

        update() {
            this.y += this.speed;
            this.x += this.wind + Math.sin(this.y * this.swingSpeed + this.swingOffset) * 0.4;
            this.rotation += CONFIG.rotationSpeed * this.rotationDir;

            if (this.y > window.innerHeight + 30 || this.x < -30 || this.x > window.innerWidth + 30) {
                this.reset();
            }
        }

        draw(ctx) {
            if (!leafImg.complete || leafImg.naturalWidth === 0) return;

            ctx.save();
            ctx.translate(this.x, this.y);
            ctx.rotate(this.rotation);
            ctx.globalAlpha = this.opacity;
            ctx.drawImage(leafImg, -this.size / 2, -this.size / 2, this.size, this.size);
            ctx.restore();
        }
    }

    // 动画主循环
    function animate() {
        if (!ctx) return; 
        ctx.clearRect(0, 0, window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);

        for (const leaf of leaves) {
            leaf.update();
            leaf.draw(ctx);
        }

        animationFrameId = requestAnimationFrame(animate);
    }

    // ==========================================
    // 遥控器按键一：大管家用来“启动”枫叶下落的开关
    // ==========================================
    function start() {
        // 如果网页上已经有了，就不重复创建
        if (document.getElementById('maple-leaves-canvas')) return;

        // 1. 动态组装画布
        canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
        canvas.id = 'maple-leaves-canvas';
        ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

        // 2. 注入样式
        canvas.style.position = 'fixed';
        canvas.style.top = '0';
        canvas.style.left = '0';
        canvas.style.width = '100%';
        canvas.style.height = '100%';
        canvas.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
        canvas.style.zIndex = '999996';
        canvas.style.willChange = 'transform';
        document.body.appendChild(canvas);

        // 3. 绑定视口缩放
        window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
        resize();

        // 4. 装填枫叶粒子池
        leaves = [];
        for (let i = 0; i < CONFIG.maxLeaves; i++) {
            leaves.push(new Leaf(true));
        }

        // 5. 启动动画循环
        if (leafImg.complete) {
            animate();
        } else {
            leafImg.onload = animate;
        }
    }

    // ==========================================
    // 遥控器按键二：大管家用来“关闭并抹除”枫叶的开关
    // ==========================================
    function stop() {
        // 1. 停掉后台动画刷新循环，节约显卡性能
        if (animationFrameId) {
            cancelAnimationFrame(animationFrameId);
            animationFrameId = null;
        }

        // 2. 解绑缩放监听器，防止内存泄漏
        window.removeEventListener('resize', resize);

        // 3. 彻底将 HTML 里的画布从 DOM 树中移除
        if (canvas && canvas.parentNode) {
            canvas.parentNode.removeChild(canvas);
        }

        // 4. 清空内存变量
        canvas = null;
        ctx = null;
        leaves = [];
    }

    // 针对 MkDocs Material 瞬时加载模式的额外安全防御
    document.addEventListener("DOMNodeRemoved", function(e) {
        if (canvas && e.target === canvas) {
            window.removeEventListener('resize', resize);
            if (animationFrameId) cancelAnimationFrame(animationFrameId);
        }
    });

    // 挂载配置以便调试
    window.mapleLeavesConfig = CONFIG;

    // ==========================================
    // 核心出厂：把这两个按键上交给 window 供大管家调度
    // ==========================================
    return {
        start: start,
        stop: stop
    };

})();

    (function () {
    // 检查是否已经存在，防止 MkDocs 异步刷新重复创建
    if (document.getElementById('sakura-petals-canvas')) return;

    const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    canvas.id = 'sakura-petals-canvas';
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    let petals = [];
    let animationFrameId = null; // 用于记录动画定时器

    // ========== 可配置参数 ==========
    // 针对樱花的特性优化了速度、尺寸和摆动幅度
    const CONFIG = {
        maxPetals: 35,               // 同时存在的樱花数量（樱花通常比枫叶更密集一点点，更显浪漫）
        minSpeed: 0.4,               // 最小下落速度 (px/帧) - 比枫叶更慢、更轻盈
        maxSpeed: 1.2,               // 最大下落速度
        wind: 0.3,                   // 基础水平风向（樱花随风飘动的质感更强）
        minSize: 8,                  // 樱花瓣最小尺寸 (px)
        maxSize: 24,                 // 樱花瓣最大尺寸 (px)
        opacityRange: [0.4, 0.8],    // 不透明度范围 [最小, 最大]
        rotationSpeed: 0.01,         // 自转速度
    };

    // 样式设置
    canvas.style.position = 'fixed';
    canvas.style.top = '0';
    canvas.style.left = '0';
    canvas.style.width = '100%';
    canvas.style.height = '100%';
    canvas.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
    canvas.style.zIndex = '999996';
    canvas.style.willChange = 'transform'; // 提示浏览器该层可能发生硬件加速转换
    document.body.appendChild(canvas);

    // 解决高清屏模糊的核心逻辑
    function resize() {
        const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
        canvas.width = window.innerWidth * dpr;
        canvas.height = window.innerHeight * dpr;
        ctx.scale(dpr, dpr); // 缩放绘图上下文以匹配物理像素
    }
    window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
    resize();

    // 鲁棒路径：自动匹配目录并加载 sakura.svg
    const sakuraImg = new Image();
    try {
        const currentScript = document.querySelector('script[src*="background.js"]');
        if (currentScript) {
            sakuraImg.src = currentScript.src.replace('js/background.js', 'svg/sakura.svg');
        } else {
            sakuraImg.src = 'assets/svg/sakura.svg'; // 回退相对路径
        }
    } catch (e) {
        sakuraImg.src = 'assets/svg/sakura.svg';
    }

    class SakuraPetal {
        constructor(initial = false) {
            this.reset(initial);
        }

        reset(initial = false) {
            // 坐标逻辑依然使用 innerWidth/Height 的逻辑空间
            this.x = Math.random() * window.innerWidth;
            this.y = initial ? Math.random() * window.innerHeight : -Math.random() * 30;
            this.size = CONFIG.minSize + Math.random() * (CONFIG.maxSize - CONFIG.minSize);
            this.speed = CONFIG.minSpeed + Math.random() * (CONFIG.maxSpeed - CONFIG.minSpeed);
            this.wind = CONFIG.wind + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.15; 
            this.rotation = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
            this.rotationDir = Math.random() < 0.5 ? -1 : 1;
            this.opacity = CONFIG.opacityRange[0] + Math.random() * (CONFIG.opacityRange[1] - CONFIG.opacityRange[0]);
            this.swingSpeed = 0.015 + Math.random() * 0.02; // 左右摆动的频率
            this.swingOffset = Math.random() * 100;
        }

        update() {
            this.y += this.speed;
            // 稍微放大了 Math.sin 内部的系数(0.6)，让花瓣在空中展现出特有的“兜风”和“翻滚”的轻盈摇摆感
            this.x += this.wind + Math.sin(this.y * this.swingSpeed + this.swingOffset) * 0.6;
            this.rotation += CONFIG.rotationSpeed * this.rotationDir;

            if (this.y > window.innerHeight + 30 || this.x < -30 || this.x > window.innerWidth + 30) {
                this.reset();
            }
        }

        draw(ctx) {
            if (!sakuraImg.complete || sakuraImg.naturalWidth === 0) return;

            ctx.save();
            ctx.translate(this.x, this.y);
            ctx.rotate(this.rotation);
            ctx.globalAlpha = this.opacity;
            ctx.drawImage(sakuraImg, -this.size / 2, -this.size / 2, this.size, this.size);
            ctx.restore();
        }
    }

    for (let i = 0; i < CONFIG.maxPetals; i++) {
        petals.push(new SakuraPetal(true));
    }

    function animate() {
        // 清理当前视口矩形
        ctx.clearRect(0, 0, window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);

        for (const petal of petals) {
            petal.update();
            petal.draw(ctx);
        }

        animationFrameId = requestAnimationFrame(animate);
    }

    if (sakuraImg.complete) {
        animate();
    } else {
        sakuraImg.onload = animate;
    }

    // 针对 MkDocs Material 瞬时加载模式的额外防御
    document.addEventListener("DOMNodeRemoved", function(e) {
        if (e.target === canvas) {
            window.removeEventListener('resize', resize);
            if (animationFrameId) cancelAnimationFrame(animationFrameId);
        }
    });

    window.sakuraConfig = CONFIG;
})();

        const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
        canvas.width = window.innerWidth * dpr;
        canvas.height = window.innerHeight * dpr;
        ctx.scale(dpr, dpr); 
    }

    // 鲁棒路径：自动匹配目录并加载 sakura.svg（保留你的智能路径资产匹配）
    const sakuraImg = new Image();
    try {
        const currentScript = document.querySelector('script[src*="background.js"]');
        if (currentScript) {
            sakuraImg.src = currentScript.src.replace('js/background.js', 'svg/sakura.svg');
        } else {
            sakuraImg.src = 'assets/svg/sakura.svg'; 
        }
    } catch (e) {
        sakuraImg.src = 'assets/svg/sakura.svg';
    }

    // 樱花花瓣粒子类
    class SakuraPetal {
        constructor(initial = false) {
            this.reset(initial);
        }

        reset(initial = false) {
            this.x = Math.random() * window.innerWidth;
            this.y = initial ? Math.random() * window.innerHeight : -Math.random() * 30;
            this.size = CONFIG.minSize + Math.random() * (CONFIG.maxSize - CONFIG.minSize);
            this.speed = CONFIG.minSpeed + Math.random() * (CONFIG.maxSpeed - CONFIG.minSpeed);
            this.wind = CONFIG.wind + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.15; 
            this.rotation = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
            this.rotationDir = Math.random() < 0.5 ? -1 : 1;
            this.opacity = CONFIG.opacityRange[0] + Math.random() * (CONFIG.opacityRange[1] - CONFIG.opacityRange[0]);
            this.swingSpeed = 0.015 + Math.random() * 0.02; 
            this.swingOffset = Math.random() * 100;
        }

        update() {
            this.y += this.speed;
            this.x += this.wind + Math.sin(this.y * this.swingSpeed + this.swingOffset) * 0.6;
            this.rotation += CONFIG.rotationSpeed * this.rotationDir;

            if (this.y > window.innerHeight + 30 || this.x < -30 || this.x > window.innerWidth + 30) {
                this.reset();
            }
        }

        draw(ctx) {
            if (!sakuraImg.complete || sakuraImg.naturalWidth === 0) return;

            ctx.save();
            ctx.translate(this.x, this.y);
            ctx.rotate(this.rotation);
            ctx.globalAlpha = this.opacity;
            ctx.drawImage(sakuraImg, -this.size / 2, -this.size / 2, this.size, this.size);
            ctx.restore();
        }
    }

    // 动画主循环
    function animate() {
        if (!ctx) return; // 安全防御
        ctx.clearRect(0, 0, window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);

        for (const petal of petals) {
            petal.update();
            petal.draw(ctx);
        }

        animationFrameId = requestAnimationFrame(animate);
    }

    // ==========================================
    // 遥控器按键一：大管家用来“启动”樱花的开关
    // ==========================================
    function start() {
        // 如果网页上已经有了，就不重复创建
        if (document.getElementById('sakura-petals-canvas')) return;

        // 1. 动态组装画布
        canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
        canvas.id = 'sakura-petals-canvas';
        ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

        // 2. 注入样式
        canvas.style.position = 'fixed';
        canvas.style.top = '0';
        canvas.style.left = '0';
        canvas.style.width = '100%';
        canvas.style.height = '100%';
        canvas.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
        canvas.style.zIndex = '999996';
        canvas.style.willChange = 'transform';
        document.body.appendChild(canvas);

        // 3. 绑定视口缩放
        window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
        resize();

        // 4. 重新装填樱花花瓣池
        petals = [];
        for (let i = 0; i < CONFIG.maxPetals; i++) {
            petals.push(new SakuraPetal(true));
        }

        // 5. 启动动画
        if (sakuraImg.complete) {
            animate();
        } else {
            sakuraImg.onload = animate;
        }
    }

    // ==========================================
    // 遥控器按键二：大管家用来“关闭并抹除”樱花的开关
    // ==========================================
    function stop() {
        // 1. 停掉后台的疯狂刷新的渲染器（不占显卡）
        if (animationFrameId) {
            cancelAnimationFrame(animationFrameId);
            animationFrameId = null;
        }

        // 2. 解绑缩放监听器（防止内存泄漏）
        window.removeEventListener('resize', resize);

        // 3. 彻底将 HTML 里的画布连根拔除
        if (canvas && canvas.parentNode) {
            canvas.parentNode.removeChild(canvas);
        }

        // 4. 彻底清空内存变量，回归婴儿般纯洁
        canvas = null;
        ctx = null;
        petals = [];
    }

    // 针对 MkDocs Material 瞬时加载模式的额外安全防御
    document.addEventListener("DOMNodeRemoved", function(e) {
        if (canvas && e.target === canvas) {
            window.removeEventListener('resize', resize);
            if (animationFrameId) cancelAnimationFrame(animationFrameId);
        }
    });

    // 顺便把配置挂载出去以便调试
    window.sakuraConfig = CONFIG;

    // ==========================================
    // 核心出厂：把这两个按键上交给 window 大大，供大管家随意点名
    // ==========================================
    return {
        start: start,
        stop: stop
    };

})();

    (function () {
    // 核心调度逻辑
    function dispatchEffect() {
        // 1. 如果发现樱花特效已经在网页内存中存在，直接按按钮启动
        if (window.EffectSakura && window.EffectSakura.start) {
            window.EffectSakura.start();
            return;
        }

        // 2. 如果内存里没有樱花特效，大管家根据你的项目路径，动态去抓取 sakura.js 文件
        const script = document.createElement('script');

        // 🌟 针对你的 MkDocs 目录结构优化的标准根路径
        script.src = '/assets/js/background/sakura.js'; 

        // 3. 樱花文件下载并执行完毕后，大管家立刻点火启动
        script.onload = function() {
            if (window.EffectSakura && window.EffectSakura.start) {
                window.EffectSakura.start();
            }
        };

        // 如果抓取失败（比如路径意外断开），在控制台打印提示，不卡死网页
        script.onerror = function() {
            console.error("大管家未能成功加载樱花特效，请检查路径是否正确。");
        };

        document.head.appendChild(script);
    }

    // ① 网页首次彻底加载完毕时，大管家点名
    if (document.readyState === 'complete') {
        dispatchEffect();
    } else {
        window.addEventListener('load', dispatchEffect);
    }

    // ② 完美适配 MkDocs Material 的 SPA 局部切页模式
    // 每次点击导航栏换页，大管家都会重新确认一遍樱花有没有在好好上班
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentSwitch", dispatchEffect);
})();

    (function () {
    // 检查是否已经存在，防止 MkDocs 异步刷新重复创建
    if (document.getElementById('sakura-petals-canvas')) return;

    const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    canvas.id = 'sakura-petals-canvas';
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    let petals = [];
    let animationFrameId = null; // 用于记录动画定时器

    // ========== 可配置参数 ==========
    const CONFIG = {
        maxPetals: 35,               // 同时存在的樱花数量
        minSpeed: 0.4,               // 最小下落速度 (px/帧)
        maxSpeed: 1.2,               // 最大下落速度
        wind: 0.3,                   // 基础水平风向
        minSize: 8,                  // 樱花瓣最小尺寸 (px)
        maxSize: 18,                 // 樱花瓣最大尺寸 (px)
        opacityRange: [0.4, 0.8],    // 不透明度范围
        rotationSpeed: 0.01,         // 平面自转速度
    };

    // 样式设置
    canvas.style.position = 'fixed';
    canvas.style.top = '0';
    canvas.style.left = '0';
    canvas.style.width = '100%';
    canvas.style.height = '100%';
    canvas.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
    canvas.style.zIndex = '999996';
    canvas.style.willChange = 'transform'; 
    document.body.appendChild(canvas);

    // 解决高清屏模糊的核心逻辑
    function resize() {
        const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
        canvas.width = window.innerWidth * dpr;
        canvas.height = window.innerHeight * dpr;
        ctx.scale(dpr, dpr); 
    }
    window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
    resize();

    // 路径匹配
    const sakuraImg = new Image();
    try {
        const currentScript = document.querySelector('script[src*="background.js"]');
        if (currentScript) {
            sakuraImg.src = currentScript.src.replace('js/background.js', 'svg/sakura.svg');
        } else {
            sakuraImg.src = 'assets/svg/sakura.svg';
        }
    } catch (e) {
        sakuraImg.src = 'assets/svg/sakura.svg';
    }

    class SakuraPetal {
        constructor(initial = false) {
            this.reset(initial);
        }

        reset(initial = false) {
            this.x = Math.random() * window.innerWidth;
            this.y = initial ? Math.random() * window.innerHeight : -Math.random() * 30;
            this.size = CONFIG.minSize + Math.random() * (CONFIG.maxSize - CONFIG.minSize);
            this.speed = CONFIG.minSpeed + Math.random() * (CONFIG.maxSpeed - CONFIG.minSpeed);
            this.wind = CONFIG.wind + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.15; 
            this.rotation = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
            this.rotationDir = Math.random() < 0.5 ? -1 : 1;
            this.opacity = CONFIG.opacityRange[0] + Math.random() * (CONFIG.opacityRange[1] - CONFIG.opacityRange[0]);
            this.swingSpeed = 0.015 + Math.random() * 0.02; 
            this.swingOffset = Math.random() * 100;

            // 新增：3D 翻转参数
            this.rotation3D = Math.random() * Math.PI;             // 初始 3D 翻转角度
            this.flipSpeed = 0.005 + Math.random() * 0.01;          // 翻转速度（值越大，翻转越快）
        }

        update() {
            this.y += this.speed;
            this.x += this.wind + Math.sin(this.y * this.swingSpeed + this.swingOffset) * 0.6;
            this.rotation += CONFIG.rotationSpeed * this.rotationDir;

            // 随着下落，累加 3D 翻转角度
            this.rotation3D += this.flipSpeed;

            if (this.y > window.innerHeight + 30 || this.x < -30 || this.x > window.innerWidth + 30) {
                this.reset();
            }
        }

        draw(ctx) {
            if (!sakuraImg.complete || sakuraImg.naturalWidth === 0) return;

            ctx.save();
            ctx.translate(this.x, this.y);
            ctx.rotate(this.rotation);

            // 【核心改动：模拟3D翻转】
            // 使用 Math.cos(rotation3D) 让缩放系数在 -1 到 1 之间周期性平滑变化
            // 这会导致图片在水平方向上被压缩、压扁、反转、再拉伸，形成完美的立体翻滚效果
            ctx.scale(Math.cos(this.rotation3D), 1);

            ctx.globalAlpha = this.opacity;
            ctx.drawImage(sakuraImg, -this.size / 2, -this.size / 2, this.size, this.size);
            ctx.restore();
        }
    }

    for (let i = 0; i < CONFIG.maxPetals; i++) {
        petals.push(new SakuraPetal(true));
    }

    function animate() {
        ctx.clearRect(0, 0, window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);

        for (const petal of petals) {
            petal.update();
            petal.draw(ctx);
        }

        animationFrameId = requestAnimationFrame(animate);
    }

    if (sakuraImg.complete) {
        animate();
    } else {
        sakuraImg.onload = animate;
    }

    // 针对 MkDocs Material 瞬时加载模式的额外防御
    document.addEventListener("DOMNodeRemoved", function(e) {
        if (e.target === canvas) {
            window.removeEventListener('resize', resize);
            if (animationFrameId) cancelAnimationFrame(animationFrameId);
        }
    });

    window.sakuraConfig = CONFIG;
})();

    (function () {
    // 1. 检查是否已经存在，防止 MkDocs 异步刷新重复创建
    if (document.getElementById('sakura-blossoms-canvas')) return;

    const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    canvas.id = 'sakura-blossoms-canvas';
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    let petals = [];
    let animationFrameId = null;

    // ========== 樱花花瓣特性可配置参数 ==========
    const CONFIG = {
        maxPetals: 35,                // 同时存在的花瓣数量（不宜过多，保持优雅感）
        minSize: 6,                   // 花瓣最小宽度 (px)
        maxSize: 14,                  // 花瓣最大宽度 (px)
        minSpeed: 0.6,                // 最小下落速度 (px/帧)
        maxSpeed: 1.5,                // 最大下落速度 (px/帧)
        baseWind: 0.2,                // 基础水平风向（正数向右，模拟微风）
        opacityRange: [0.35, 0.75],   // 不透明度范围
    };

    // 2. 样式设置（与原先的层级和穿透属性保持一致，确保不挡住文字和代码块）
    canvas.style.position = 'fixed';
    canvas.style.top = '0';
    canvas.style.left = '0';
    canvas.style.width = '100%';
    canvas.style.height = '100%';
    canvas.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
    canvas.style.zIndex = '999996';
    canvas.style.willChange = 'transform';
    document.body.appendChild(canvas);

    // 3. 解决高清屏模糊的核心逻辑
    function resize() {
        const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
        canvas.width = window.innerWidth * dpr;
        canvas.height = window.innerHeight * dpr;
        ctx.scale(dpr, dpr);
    }
    window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
    resize();

    // 4. 樱花花瓣粒子类
    class SakuraPetal {
        constructor(initial = false) {
            this.reset(initial);
        }

        reset(initial = false) {
            this.x = Math.random() * window.innerWidth;
            // 初始生成时分散在全屏，后续生成时从顶部 -30px 处落下
            this.y = initial ? Math.random() * window.innerHeight : -30;

            // 核心物理特性绑定：越大、越重的花瓣下落越快、越清晰（形成前后景深）
            const sizeProgress = Math.random(); 
            this.width = CONFIG.minSize + sizeProgress * (CONFIG.maxSize - CONFIG.minSize);
            // 花瓣通常偏椭圆，高度略大于宽度
            this.height = this.width * (1.1 + Math.random() * 0.4); 
            this.speed = CONFIG.minSpeed + sizeProgress * (CONFIG.maxSpeed - CONFIG.minSpeed);
            this.opacity = CONFIG.opacityRange[0] + sizeProgress * (CONFIG.opacityRange[1] - CONFIG.opacityRange[0]);

            // 左右轻微摆动（Sway）的参数
            this.swingSpeed = 0.01 + Math.random() * 0.015; // 摆动频率
            this.swingRadius = 0.8 + Math.random() * 1.5;   // 左右晃动的幅度
            this.swingOffset = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2; // 随机初始相位

            // 旋转与三维翻转特性（花瓣特有）
            this.rotation = Math.random() * Math.PI;        // 初始平面旋转角度
            this.rotationSpeed = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.02; // 平面旋转速度
            this.flipSpeed = 0.02 + Math.random() * 0.03;   // 在 Y 轴上翻转的速度
            this.flipOffset = Math.random() * Math.PI;      // 翻转初始相位
        }

        update() {
            this.y += this.speed;

            // 摆动与风向逻辑
            this.swingOffset += this.swingSpeed;
            this.x += CONFIG.baseWind + Math.sin(this.swingOffset) * this.swingRadius;

            // 旋转与翻转逻辑更新
            this.rotation += this.rotationSpeed;
            this.flipOffset += this.flipSpeed;

            // 边界检查：移出屏幕下方或两侧后重置
            if (this.y > window.innerHeight + 20 || this.x < -30 || this.x > window.innerWidth + 30) {
                this.reset();
            }
        }

        draw(ctx) {
            ctx.save();

            // 移动画布原点到花瓣中心，方便进行旋转和缩放
            ctx.translate(this.x, this.y);
            ctx.rotate(this.rotation);

            // 核心动态：利用 Math.sin 模拟花瓣在三维空间中的翻转缩放
            const currentFlip = Math.sin(this.flipOffset);
            ctx.scale(currentFlip, 1); 

            ctx.beginPath();

            // 绘制精美的樱花瓣形状（使用两条三次贝塞尔曲线拼接成经典的心形/复合叶形）
            ctx.moveTo(0, -this.height / 2);
            // 左半边花瓣曲线
            ctx.bezierCurveTo(
                -this.width * 0.8, -this.height * 0.4, 
                -this.width * 0.8, this.height * 0.4, 
                0, this.height / 2
            );
            // 右半边花瓣曲线
            ctx.bezierCurveTo(
                this.width * 0.8, this.height * 0.4, 
                this.width * 0.8, -this.height * 0.4, 
                0, -this.height / 2
            );

            // 渐变色填充：让花瓣有根部到尖端的色彩层次（柔和粉色）
            const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, -this.height / 2, 0, this.height / 2);
            grad.addColorStop(0, `rgba(255, 192, 203, ${this.opacity})`);     // 浅粉
            grad.addColorStop(0.9, `rgba(255, 140, 155, ${this.opacity})`);   // 深粉
            grad.addColorStop(1, `rgba(240, 128, 128, ${this.opacity * 0.8})`); // 瓣尖微暗

            ctx.fillStyle = grad;
            ctx.fill();

            ctx.restore();
        }
    }

    // 5. 初始化花瓣池
    for (let i = 0; i < CONFIG.maxPetals; i++) {
        petals.push(new SakuraPetal(true));
    }

    // 6. 主动画循环
    function animate() {
        ctx.clearRect(0, 0, window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);

        for (const petal of petals) {
            petal.update();
            petal.draw(ctx);
        }

        animationFrameId = requestAnimationFrame(animate);
    }

    // 7. 启动动画
    animate();

    // 8. 针对 MkDocs Material 瞬时加载（Pjax/SPA）模式的内存清理防御机制
    document.addEventListener("DOMNodeRemoved", function(e) {
        if (e.target === canvas) {
            window.removeEventListener('resize', resize);
            if (animationFrameId) cancelAnimationFrame(animationFrameId);
        }
    });

    // 9. 暴露配置项方便后续控制台微调
    window.sakuraConfig = CONFIG;
})();
