    (function () {
    if (document.getElementById('lightning-canvas')) return;

    const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    canvas.id = 'lightning-canvas';
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    let animationFrameId = null;

    // ========== 闪电特性可配置参数 ==========
    const CONFIG = {
        minInterval: 4000,       // 两次闪电之间的最小间隔时间 (ms)
        maxInterval: 9000,       // 两次闪电之间的最大间隔时间 (ms)
        branchProbability: 0.28, // 闪电生出分支的概率
        maxBranchDepth: 3,       // 分支最大层级
        lightningColor: 'rgba(220, 235, 255, 1)',  // 闪电核心颜色
        glowColor: 'rgba(140, 180, 255, 0.6)',     // 闪电外发光颜色

        // --- 新增：残影与速度控制参数 ---
        retentionFrames: 18,     // 闪电在屏幕上滞留/逐渐变淡的总帧数（数值越大，停留越久，变相“放慢”）
    };

    let nextLightningTime = Date.now() + Math.random() * CONFIG.maxInterval;
    let flashOpacity = 0;       

    // 核心改变：闪电生命周期管理器
    let lightningLife = 0;       // 当前闪电剩余生命帧数
    let currentLightnings = []; // 存储当前闪电的线段

    canvas.style.position = 'fixed';
    canvas.style.top = '0';
    canvas.style.left = '0';
    canvas.style.width = '100%';
    canvas.style.height = '100%';
    canvas.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
    canvas.style.zIndex = '999996';
    canvas.style.willChange = 'transform';
    document.body.appendChild(canvas);

    function resize() {
        const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
        canvas.width = window.innerWidth * dpr;
        canvas.height = window.innerHeight * dpr;
        ctx.scale(dpr, dpr);
    }
    window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
    resize();

    // 递归生成闪电线段
    function createLightningBranch(startX, startY, endX, endY, displace, depth) {
        if (depth > CONFIG.maxBranchDepth) return [];

        let segments = [];
        const midX = (startX + endX) / 2;
        const midY = (startY + endY) / 2;

        // 引入大范围扰动，让折线更狂野
        const normalDisplace = (Math.random() - 0.5) * displace;
        const actualMidX = midX + normalDisplace;

        if (endY - startY < 18) {
            segments.push({ x1: startX, y1: startY, x2: endX, y2: endY, depth: depth });
        } else {
            segments = segments.concat(createLightningBranch(startX, startY, actualMidX, midY, displace * 0.5, depth));
            segments = segments.concat(createLightningBranch(actualMidX, midY, endX, endY, displace * 0.5, depth));

            if (Math.random() < CONFIG.branchProbability) {
                // 分支走向完全随机，突破“向中间靠拢”的魔咒
                const angle = (Math.random() * 0.4 + 0.1) * Math.PI; // 倾斜角度
                const dir = Math.random() > 0.5 ? 1 : -1;
                const length = Math.random() * 120 + 40;

                const branchEndX = actualMidX + Math.sin(angle) * length * dir;
                const branchEndY = midY + Math.cos(angle) * length;

                segments = segments.concat(createLightningBranch(actualMidX, midY, branchEndX, branchEndY, displace * 0.4, depth + 1));
            }
        }
        return segments;
    }

    // 触发一次全新闪电
    function triggerLightning() {
        // 1. 解决不随机问题：起点横跨全屏
        const startX = Math.random() * window.innerWidth;
        const startY = -10; 

        // 2. 解决不随机问题：终点目标完全由起点决定，并允许极大的横向跨度（撕裂全屏）
        const maxOffset = window.innerWidth * 0.4; // 允许横向跨越40%的屏幕宽度
        const endX = startX + (Math.random() - 0.5) * maxOffset;
        const endY = window.innerHeight * (0.7 + Math.random() * 0.3);

        currentLightnings = createLightningBranch(startX, startY, endX, endY, 150, 1);

        // 重置生命周期（开始倒计时残影）
        lightningLife = CONFIG.retentionFrames;

        // 全屏电光闪烁（调低一点，配合残影更自然）
        flashOpacity = 0.2; 

        const delay = CONFIG.minInterval + Math.random() * (CONFIG.maxInterval - CONFIG.minInterval);
        nextLightningTime = Date.now() + delay;
    }

    // 主动画循环
    function animate() {
        ctx.clearRect(0, 0, window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);

        const now = Date.now();
        if (now > nextLightningTime && lightningLife === 0) {
            triggerLightning();
        }

        // 1. 绘制天空全屏瞬闪
        if (flashOpacity > 0) {
            ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255, 255, 255, ${flashOpacity})`;
            ctx.fillRect(0, 0, window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
            flashOpacity *= 0.82; 
            if (flashOpacity < 0.01) flashOpacity = 0;
        }

        // 2. 绘制带残影和慢放效果的闪电
        if (lightningLife > 0 && currentLightnings.length > 0) {
            ctx.save();

            // 计算当前帧的衰减系数 (生命值越低，画面越淡)
            const lifeRatio = lightningLife / CONFIG.retentionFrames;

            // 模拟闪电的“高频抽搐/颤抖”感 (极其逼真)
            const flicker = Math.random() > 0.3 ? 1 : 0.2;
            const currentOpacity = lifeRatio * flicker;

            for (const seg of currentLightnings) {
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.moveTo(seg.x1, seg.y1);
                ctx.lineTo(seg.x2, seg.y2);

                const isMain = seg.depth === 1;

                // 动态控制残影颜色透明度
                ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(220, 235, 255, ${currentOpacity})`;
                ctx.lineWidth = isMain ? (2 + Math.random() * 1.5) : 0.8; 

                // 发光层随时间淡出
                ctx.shadowBlur = isMain ? (15 * lifeRatio) : 4;
                ctx.shadowColor = CONFIG.glowColor;

                ctx.stroke();
            }

            ctx.restore();

            // 递减生命值，控制留存时间
            lightningLife--;
        }

        animationFrameId = requestAnimationFrame(animate);
    }

    animate();

    // 针对 MkDocs Material SPA 模式的内存清理防御机制
    document.addEventListener("DOMNodeRemoved", function(e) {
        if (e.target === canvas) {
            window.removeEventListener('resize', resize);
            if (animationFrameId) cancelAnimationFrame(animationFrameId);
        }
    });

    window.lightningConfig = CONFIG;
})();

    // docs/assets/js/knowledge_network.js – 知识图谱/神经元网络动态连线
(function () {
    const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    canvas.id = 'knowledge-network-canvas';
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    let particles = [];

    // ========== 可配置参数 ==========
    const CONFIG = {
        maxParticles: 70,           // 粒子总数（由于需要双重循环计算连线，70个是性能与视觉的黄金平衡点）
        minSpeed: 0.2,              // 最小漂浮速度
        maxSpeed: 0.6,              // 最大漂浮速度
        minRadius: 1.5,             // 粒子最小半径 (px)
        maxRadius: 4.0,             // 粒子最大半径 (px)
        lineDistance: 110,          // 触发连线的最大距离 (px)
        mouseDistance: 160,         // 鼠标互动感应的半径距离 (px)

        // 动态色彩配置（自动适配 MkDocs 明暗主题）
        lightMode: { particle: 'rgba(100, 110, 130, 0.3)', line: '100, 110, 130' }, // 亮色模式：优雅灰蓝
        darkMode: { particle: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.4)', line: '255, 255, 255' }    // 暗黑模式：璀璨星白
    };

    // 存储当前鼠标位置
    let mouse = { x: null, y: null };

    // 画布样式 —— 依然是高层级无感穿透
    canvas.style.position = 'fixed';
    canvas.style.top = '0';
    canvas.style.bottom = '0';
    canvas.style.margin = '0';
    canvas.style.padding = '0';
    canvas.style.left = '0';
    canvas.style.right = '0';
    canvas.style.width = '100%';
    canvas.style.height = '100%';
    canvas.style.pointerEvents = 'none'; // 核心：完全不影响文字选中与链接点击
    canvas.style.zIndex = '999994';      // 浮在内容最上层
    canvas.style.transform = 'none';     
    canvas.style.willChange = 'auto';    
    document.body.appendChild(canvas);

    function resize() {
        canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
        canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
    }
    window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
    resize();

    // 监听鼠标移动与离开（虽然 pointer-events 为 none 无法在 canvas 触发，但我们可以在 window 捕获鼠标）
    window.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
        mouse.x = e.clientX;
        mouse.y = e.clientY;
    });
    window.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
        mouse.x = null;
        mouse.y = null;
    });

    // 辅助函数：获取当前明暗主题
    function getTheme() {
        const scheme = document.body.getAttribute('data-md-color-scheme');
        return scheme === 'slate' ? CONFIG.darkMode : CONFIG.lightMode;
    }

    class Particle {
        constructor(initial = false) {
            this.reset(initial);
        }

        reset(initial = false) {
            // 初始时全屏随机散落，后续重置只在边界生成
            this.x = Math.random() * canvas.width;
            this.y = Math.random() * canvas.height;
            this.radius = CONFIG.minRadius + Math.random() * (CONFIG.maxRadius - CONFIG.minRadius);

            // 随机漂浮方向（360度）
            const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
            const speed = CONFIG.minSpeed + Math.random() * (CONFIG.maxSpeed - CONFIG.minSpeed);
            this.vx = Math.cos(angle) * speed;
            this.vy = Math.sin(angle) * speed;
        }

        update() {
            this.x += this.vx;
            this.y += this.vy;

            // 碰壁反弹逻辑，保持“网状结构”始终留在屏幕内
            if (this.x < 0 || this.x > canvas.width) this.vx *= -1;
            if (this.y < 0 || this.y > canvas.height) this.vy *= -1;
        }

        draw(ctx, theme) {
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.arc(this.x, this.y, this.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            ctx.fillStyle = theme.particle;
            ctx.fill();
        }
    }

    // 初始化粒子群
    for (let i = 0; i < CONFIG.maxParticles; i++) {
        particles.push(new Particle(true));
    }

    // 核心算法：连接临近的知识节点（图谱绘制）
    function drawLines(theme) {
        const len = particles.length;
        for (let i = 0; i < len; i++) {
            // 1. 计算粒子与鼠标之间的连线
            if (mouse.x !== null && mouse.y !== null) {
                const dxMouse = particles[i].x - mouse.x;
                const dyMouse = particles[i].y - mouse.y;
                const distMouse = Math.sqrt(dxMouse * dxMouse + dyMouse * dyMouse);

                if (distMouse < CONFIG.mouseDistance) {
                    // 越接近鼠标，线条和粒子透明度越高（产生磁吸高亮效果）
                    const alpha = (1 - distMouse / CONFIG.mouseDistance) * 0.4;
                    ctx.beginPath();
                    ctx.moveTo(particles[i].x, particles[i].y);
                    ctx.lineTo(mouse.x, mouse.y);
                    ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(${theme.line}, ${alpha})`;
                    ctx.lineWidth = 1.2;
                    ctx.stroke();
                }
            }

            // 2. 双重循环：计算粒子与粒子之间的连线
            for (let j = i + 1; j < len; j++) {
                const dx = particles[i].x - particles[j].x;
                const dy = particles[i].y - particles[j].y;
                const dist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);

                if (dist < CONFIG.lineDistance) {
                    // 经典的图谱联动算法：线段透明度随着距离拉远而平滑淡出
                    const alpha = (1 - dist / CONFIG.lineDistance) * 0.25;
                    ctx.beginPath();
                    ctx.moveTo(particles[i].x, particles[i].y);
                    ctx.lineTo(particles[j].x, particles[j].y);
                    ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(${theme.line}, ${alpha})`;
                    ctx.lineWidth = 0.8;
                    ctx.stroke();
                }
            }
        }
    }

    function animate() {
        ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
        const currentTheme = getTheme();

        // 运动并绘制粒子
        for (const particle of particles) {
            particle.update();
            particle.draw(ctx, currentTheme);
        }

        // 渲染图谱连线
        drawLines(currentTheme);

        requestAnimationFrame(animate);
    }

    animate();

    // 暴露配置供控制台动态调试
    window.knowledgeNetworkConfig = CONFIG;
})();

    (function () {
    // ==========================================
    // 1. 核心配置区：定义特工的名字和它们的存放路径
    // ==========================================
    const EFFECTS = {
        Sakura: {
            globalName: 'EffectSakura',                  // 樱花在网页池子里的名字
            path: '/assets/js/background/sakura.js'      // 樱花文件的网络路径
        },
        Star: {
            globalName: 'EffectStar',                    // 星星在网页池子里的名字
            path: '/assets/js/background/star_rain.js'   // 星星文件的网络路径
        }
    };

    // ==========================================
    // 2. 强力清理区：让所有人下班，消灭所有 Canvas 画布
    // ==========================================
    function stopAllEffects() {
        // 挨个检查，只要发现谁在上班，立刻按下它的 stop() 遥控器
        if (window.EffectSakura && window.EffectSakura.stop) {
            window.EffectSakura.stop();
        }
        if (window.EffectStar && window.EffectStar.stop) {
            window.EffectStar.stop();
        }
    }

    // ==========================================
    // 3. 动态加载与启动区（核心引擎）(让指定的特效上班)
    // ==========================================
    function loadAndStart(effectKey) {
        const effect = EFFECTS[effectKey];
        const globalObj = window[effect.globalName];

        // 【步骤甲】如果这个特工之前已经下载过了，直接按下启动键
        if (globalObj && globalObj.start) {
            globalObj.start();
            return;
        }

        // 【步骤乙】如果池子里没有，大管家动态创建一个 <script> 标签去下载它
        const script = document.createElement('script');
        script.src = effect.path;

        // 文件下载并执行完毕后的回调函数
        script.onload = function() {
            // 再次确认特工已经成功登记，然后点火启动
            if (window[effect.globalName] && window[effect.globalName].start) {
                window[effect.globalName].start();
            }
        };

        // 容错处理：万一文件路径断了，在控制台报警，不卡死正常网页
        script.onerror = function() {
            console.error(`【大管家报错】未能成功加载特效文件: ${effect.path}，请检查路径。`);
        };

        document.head.appendChild(script);
    }

    // ==========================================
    // 4. 总指挥部：时间判断与精准调度
    // ==========================================
    function dispatchEffect() {
        // ① 每次指挥前，先大刀阔斧地“全员拉闸”，确保绝对不会出现两个特效同时打架的情况
        stopAllEffects();

        // ② 获取当前的系统小时数 (0 到 23 之间的整数)
        const hour = new Date().getHours();

        // ③ 根据你的要求划分白天与黑夜：
        // 早上 6 点 到 晚上 18 点（不含18点）之间为白天
        if (hour >= 6 && hour < 18) {
            // 🌸 白天：无条件呼叫樱花特工
            loadAndStart('Sakura');
        } 
        // 其余时间（0点~6点，以及18点~24点）均为夜晚
        else {
            // ✨ 夜晚：无条件呼叫星星雨特工
            loadAndStart('Star');
        }
    }

    // ==========================================
    // 5. 自动化监听机制（大管家的耳朵和眼睛）
    // ==========================================

    // 监听 A：当用户第一次彻底打开网页或按 F5 刷新时，大管家立刻算时间看天气
    if (document.readyState === 'complete') {
        dispatchEffect();
    } else {
        window.addEventListener('load', dispatchEffect);
    }

    // 监听 B：完美适配 MkDocs Material 的 SPA 切页
    // 每次点击导航栏局部换页时，大管家都会重新确认一遍：“新页面里对应的特效有没有在好好跑？”
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentSwitch", dispatchEffect);

})();

    (function () {
    // ==========================================
    // 1. 核心配置区：登记特工档案
    // ==========================================
    const EFFECTS = {
        Sakura: { globalName: 'EffectSakura', path: '/assets/js/background/sakura.js' },
        Star:   { globalName: 'EffectStar',   path: '/assets/js/background/star_rain.js' },
        Maple:  { globalName: 'EffectMaple',  path: '/assets/js/background/maple_leaf.js' }
    };

    // ==========================================
    // 2. 节气季节判断器（核心算法）
    // ==========================================
    function getSeason() {
        const now = new Date();
        const m = now.getMonth() + 1; // 1-12
        const d = now.getDate();
        // 简化版核心日期对齐（立春2.4，立夏5.5，立秋8.7，立冬11.7）
        const ds = `${m}-${d}`;
        if (ds >= '2-4' && ds < '5-5') return 'spring';
        if (ds >= '5-5' && ds < '8-7') return 'summer';
        if (ds >= '8-7' && ds < '11-7') return 'autumn';
        return 'winter';
    }

    // ==========================================
    // 3. 强力清理区：一键拉闸
    // ==========================================
    function stopAllEffects() {
        const names = ['EffectSakura', 'EffectStar', 'EffectMaple'];
        names.forEach(name => {
            if (window[name] && window[name].stop) window[name].stop();
        });
    }

    // ==========================================
    // 4. 动态加载与启动引擎
    // ==========================================
    function loadAndStart(effectKey) {
        const effect = EFFECTS[effectKey];
        if (!effect) return;
        const globalObj = window[effect.globalName];

        if (globalObj && globalObj.start) {
            globalObj.start();
            return;
        }

        const script = document.createElement('script');
        script.src = effect.path;
        script.onload = () => {
            if (window[effect.globalName] && window[effect.globalName].start) {
                window[effect.globalName].start();
            }
        };
        document.head.appendChild(script);
    }

    // ==========================================
    // 5. 总指挥部：时令 + 时间调度
    // ==========================================
    function dispatchEffect() {
        stopAllEffects();

        const hour = new Date().getHours();
        const isNight = (hour < 6 || hour >= 18);

        // 如果是夜晚，无条件星星雨
        if (isNight) {
            loadAndStart('Star');
            return;
        }

        // 白天根据节气调度
        const season = getSeason();
        switch (season) {
            case 'spring': loadAndStart('Sakura'); break;
            case 'summer': loadAndStart('Sakura'); break; // 暂用樱花代替
            case 'autumn': loadAndStart('Maple');  break;
            case 'winter': loadAndStart('Maple');  break; // 暂用枫叶代替
        }
    }

    // ==========================================
    // 6. 自动化监听
    // ==========================================
    if (document.readyState === 'complete') dispatchEffect();
    else window.addEventListener('load', dispatchEffect);
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentSwitch", dispatchEffect);

})();

    (function () {
    // ==========================================
    // 1. 核心配置区：登记所有特工
    // ==========================================
    const EFFECTS = {
        Sakura: { globalName: 'EffectSakura', path: '/assets/js/background/sakura.js' },
        Star:   { globalName: 'EffectStar',   path: '/assets/js/background/star_rain.js' },
        Maple:  { globalName: 'EffectMaple',  path: '/assets/js/background/maple_leaf.js' },
        Snow:   { globalName: 'EffectSnow',   path: '/assets/js/background/snow.js' } // 新增：雪花
    };

    // ==========================================
    // 2. 节气季节判断器
    // ==========================================
    function getSeason() {
        const now = new Date();
        const m = now.getMonth() + 1;
        const d = now.getDate();
        const ds = `${m}-${d}`;
        if (ds >= '2-4' && ds < '5-5') return 'spring';
        if (ds >= '5-5' && ds < '8-7') return 'summer';
        if (ds >= '8-7' && ds < '11-7') return 'autumn';
        return 'winter';
    }

    // ==========================================
    // 3. 强力清理区：一键拉闸（所有特效必须在此注册）
    // ==========================================
    function stopAllEffects() {
        const names = ['EffectSakura', 'EffectStar', 'EffectMaple', 'EffectSnow'];
        names.forEach(name => {
            if (window[name] && window[name].stop) window[name].stop();
        });
    }

    // ==========================================
    // 4. 动态加载与启动引擎
    // ==========================================
    function loadAndStart(effectKey) {
        const effect = EFFECTS[effectKey];
        if (!effect) return;
        const globalObj = window[effect.globalName];

        if (globalObj && globalObj.start) {
            globalObj.start();
            return;
        }

        const script = document.createElement('script');
        script.src = effect.path;
        script.onload = () => {
            if (window[effect.globalName] && window[effect.globalName].start) {
                window[effect.globalName].start();
            }
        };
        script.onerror = () => console.error(`【大管家】特效加载失败: ${effect.path}`);
        document.head.appendChild(script);
    }

    // ==========================================
    // 5. 总指挥部：时令 + 时间调度
    // ==========================================
    function dispatchEffect() {
        stopAllEffects(); // 先把所有在跑的特效强制下班

        const hour = new Date().getHours();
        const isNight = (hour < 6 || hour >= 18);

        // 如果是夜晚，无条件星星雨
        if (isNight) {
            loadAndStart('Star');
            return;
        }

        // 白天根据节气调度
        const season = getSeason();
        switch (season) {
            case 'spring': loadAndStart('Sakura'); break;
            case 'summer': loadAndStart('Sakura'); break; // 后续改为夏季特效
            case 'autumn': loadAndStart('Maple');  break;
            case 'winter': loadAndStart('Snow');   break; // 已更新：冬天调用雪花
        }
    }

    // ==========================================
    // 6. 自动化监听
    // ==========================================
    if (document.readyState === 'complete') dispatchEffect();
    else window.addEventListener('load', dispatchEffect);
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentSwitch", dispatchEffect);
})();
